  (kernel : GeometricReview18C.Ideles K → GeometricReview18C.Ideles K → ℂ) (x y : GeometricReview18C.Ideles K) :
  (GeometricReview18C.unitMask K Q y - GeometricReview18C.unitMask K P y) * kernel x y *
        GeometricReview18C.unitMask K R y =
      (GeometricReview18C.unitMask K Q y - GeometricReview18C.unitMask K P y) * kernel x y ↔
    (GeometricReview18C.unitMask K Q y - GeometricReview18C.unitMask K P y) * kernel x y = 0
